Medical_Issue_Summary: Public educational disclaimer banner positioning and non-diagnostic clarification

Medical_Issue_Summary: Mode selector label clarity between standard and in-depth clinician view
Corrective_Action_Taken: Verified non-diagnostic dual-mode toggle labeling (Mode: Founder vs Mode: Đại chúng) avoiding clinical endorsement claims

Medical_Issue_Summary: Direct physician access and eye-care night mode accessibility
Corrective_Action_Taken: Eye-care midnight navy theme with high-contrast medical legibility and audit readiness

Medical_Issue_Summary: Rigid 15-30s circulation delay formula presented as universal physiological constant
Corrective_Action_Taken: Removed 15-30s rule; replaced with physiological lung-to-finger circulation time (LFCT) framing influenced by cardiac output, stroke volume, and arterial distance

Medical_Issue_Summary: Inaccurate SpO2 threshold framing presenting SpO2 < 90% as universal emergency cutoff rather than nocturnal hypoxemia metric
Corrective_Action_Taken: Contextualized SpO2 < 90% in nocturnal monitoring as cumulative hypoxemia burden (T90 metric) rather than acute emergency threshold

Medical_Issue_Summary: Unqualified 3-15s arousal duration presenting EEG micro-arousals as simple waking events
Corrective_Action_Taken: Removed 3-15s rule; defined micro-arousal strictly by AASM EEG criteria (>=3s shift) and explicitly separated from macro-awakenings

Medical_Issue_Summary: Conflation of Carotid Body (chemoreceptors) and Carotid Sinus (baroreceptors) in autonomic reflex explanation
Corrective_Action_Taken: Explicitly distinguished carotid body (PaO2/PaCO2/pH chemoreceptor) from carotid sinus (stretch/blood pressure baroreceptor)

Medical_Issue_Summary: Teleological and oversimplified claim attributing nocturia purely to atrial stretch and ANP dump
Corrective_Action_Taken: Removed hyperbolic metaphor; explained multifactorial nocturia involving negative intrathoracic pressure, ANP release, and sleep fragmentation

Medical_Issue_Summary: Overgeneralized sleep position claims suggesting side-sleeping is a universal cure for all OSA severities
Corrective_Action_Taken: Restricted positional therapy indications strictly to position-dependent OSA (POSA) and mild-moderate phenotypes

Medical_Issue_Summary: Aggressive marketing and commercial bias claiming smart rings are definitively superior to medical wrist sensors
Corrective_Action_Taken: Replaced commercial bias with physiological comparison of digital arteries vs radial artery perfusion and motion artifact susceptibility

Medical_Issue_Summary: Unsupported statistical claims regarding snoring prevalence (80-90% vs 30-40% / 50% men) without source stratification
Corrective_Action_Taken: Aligned snoring epidemiology with canonical reference data on benign snoring vs obstructive hypopnea/apnea

Medical_Issue_Summary: Rigid definition stating minimally symptomatic OSA is defined as AHI > 30 and ESS < 10
Corrective_Action_Taken: Clarified that minimally symptomatic / asymptomatic OSA exists across severity spectrum and ESS score does not correlate linearly with AHI

Medical_Issue_Summary: Rigid 100% (0.0mm) airway obstruction claim in functional apnea simulation misleading users on anatomical vs functional closure
Corrective_Action_Taken: Replaced absolute 100% (0.0mm) with qualitative functional collapse notation (Tắc nghẽn chức năng Mô phỏng)

Medical_Issue_Summary: Automated screenshot integrity requiring 100% positive semantic DOM state assertions before pixel capture
Corrective_Action_Taken: Built positive DOM assertion framework matching every state ID to verified DOM selectors and expected labels prior to screenshot capture
